office_does: A State Senator writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets, and confirms the governor's appointees.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Jeff Holy (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Incumbent 6th District state senator, a retired Spokane police detective and attorney; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Two-term state senator and former three-term state representative; retired Spokane police detective and attorney [S1]
Voted Nay on ESSB 6346, the 2026 tax on income over $1 million [S2]
Worked with a Democratic senator on a bipartisan bill to limit license-plate-reader surveillance [S3]
